trap.wrong: She said me she will go. He is interested to sing. The cake was ate. Put the light off up.
trap.right: She told me she would go. He is interested in singing. The cake was eaten. Put the light on.
trap.why: Itens da avaliação: said me, recuo, interested in -ing, passiva com particípio e put on/off/up. O português facilita todos esses erros.
